pick.headline: Boston, Medical Capital of America, Offers World-Class Care to Anyone Already Inside
pick.take: The city has hospitals famous worldwide, each with a new wing and a naming opportunity, but not enough primary care doctors to go around. It turns out a donor plaque is easier to fund than a Tuesday appointment. Patients can access the cutting edge once someone refers them, which requires the thing they can't find.
